title: Panoptes bench dataset row
description: One row of a community-contributed evaluation dataset. A dataset is a CSV or JSONL file whose rows/records validate against this schema. Raw contributed data stays with the contributor; only a signed pointer manifest enters the repository.

group.description: Leakage-control group (e.g. prompt or topic id). Rows sharing a group never straddle a train/calibration/test split.

author.description: Independent author identifier. Rows sharing an author never straddle a train/calibration/test split.

domain.description: Domain or genre label used for transportability slices (journalism, academic, code, ...).

source.description: Source or story identifier for source-disjoint splits.
